title: JDBC-style PgWire catalog probe expansion
scope: Continue PgWire/JDBC benchmark adapter readiness after BENCHPROD-086 by covering additional PostgreSQL metadata probes commonly used by JDBC, pgbench, BenchBase, and tool bootstraps.
constraints: Do not claim full PostgreSQL/JDBC compatibility
Do not weaken benchmark gate thresholds or allowlists

steps.step: Extend PgWire metadata fast-path with server settings and JDBC catalog tables
Add pgwire_smoke.py probes for the new metadata surface
Run release smoke with the final probe set
Run static checks and PgWire integration tests

database_changes: Added PgWire metadata handling for SHOW server_version and SHOW server_encoding.
Added current_setting('server_version'), current_setting('server_encoding'), current_setting('client_encoding'), current_setting('search_path'), and current_setting('application_name').
Added virtual pg_catalog.pg_database and pg_catalog.pg_attribute rows.
Expanded pg_catalog.pg_namespace and pg_catalog.pg_class with additional JDBC-style fields.
tests: python -m py_compile pgwire_smoke.py fusiondb_bench.py bench_repeat.py bench_stability.py bench_gate.py fusiondb_matrix.py external_smoke.py external_bootstrap.py
